description: This source file defines a custom React hook called useLocalStorage that synchronizes a state value with local storage, including helper functions for safe JSON parsing and deep equality checks. It manages reading from local storage on initialization and updates local storage whenever the state changes, avoiding unnecessary writes.

methods.name: safeJsonParse(raw, fallback)
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning a fallback value if parsing fails or input is null.

methods.name: jsonEqual(a, b)
methods.description: Compares two values for deep equality by checking if their JSON string representations are equal.

methods.name: useLocalStorage(key, initialValue)
methods.description: A React hook that synchronizes a state value with local storage, initializing from local storage and updating storage on state changes.
